evidence: Reorganizes wallet implementation code by moving migration methods out of wallet.cpp into dedicated migration files and renaming legacy BDB files.
rationale: Modularizes legacy wallet migration out of the monolithic wallet.cpp into dedicated files. The PR author notes that 'wallet/wallet.cpp file is quite hard to reason about' and exceeds 4,500 lines, with this move extracting roughly 800 lines to separate descriptor operations from legacy migration logic. While beneficial for code maintainability, it is an internal refactor that introduces no user-facing changes, bug fixes, or performance improvements.
